Thread.EEAllocContext.GCAllocationContext: Embedded GC allocation context for the thread
Thread.ExceptionInfo.ContextRecord: Pointer to the OS `CONTEXT` the OS dispatcher pushed for this exception
Thread.ExceptionInfo.ExceptionRecord: Pointer to the OS `EXCEPTION_RECORD` the OS dispatcher pushed for this exception
Thread.ExceptionInfo.ExceptionWatsonBucketTrack: Pointer to Watson unhandled buckets on non-Unix
Thread.ExceptionInfo.PreviousNestedInfo: Pointer to previous nested exception info
Thread.ExceptionInfo.ThrownObject: Handle to the thrown exception object
Thread.GCAllocContext.AllocBytes: Number of bytes allocated on SOH by this context
Thread.GCAllocContext.AllocBytesLoh: Number of bytes allocated not on SOH by this context
Thread.IdDispenser.IdToThread: Array mapping small thread IDs to thread pointers
Thread.InFlightTLSData.Next: Pointer to next in-flight TLS data entry
Thread.InFlightTLSData.TLSData: Object handle to the TLS data for the static field
Thread.InFlightTLSData.TlsIndex: TLS index for the in-flight static field
Thread.RuntimeThreadLocals.AllocContext: GC allocation context for the thread
Thread.Thread.CachedStackBase: Pointer to the base of the stack
Thread.Thread.CachedStackLimit: Pointer to the limit of the stack
Thread.Thread.CurrentCustomDebuggerNotification: Handle to the current custom debugger notification object
Thread.Thread.DebuggerControlledThreadState: Thread state flags controlled by the debugger
Thread.Thread.DebuggerFilterContext: Pointer to the debugger filter context for the thread
Thread.Thread.ExposedObject: Handle to the managed `Thread` object exposed to the debugger
Thread.Thread.GCFrame: Pointer to the head of the thread's GCFrame chain.
Thread.Thread.InteropDebuggingHijacked: Whether the thread has been hijacked for interop debugging
Thread.Thread.LastThrownObject: Handle to last thrown exception object
Thread.Thread.LastThrownObjectIsUnhandled: Whether `LastThrownObject` should be treated as unhandled
Thread.Thread.PreemptiveGCDisabled: Flag indicating if preemptive GC is disabled
Thread.Thread.ThreadHandle: OS thread handle (optional, Windows only; readers should expect `TargetPointer.Null` on non-Windows targets)
Thread.Thread.ThreadLocalDataPtr: Pointer to thread local data structure
Thread.Thread.UEWatsonBucketTrackerBuckets: Pointer to thread Watson buckets data (optional, Windows only)
Thread.ThreadLocalData.CollectibleTlsArrayData: Pointer to collectible TLS array data
Thread.ThreadLocalData.CollectibleTlsDataCount: Count of collectible TLS data entries
Thread.ThreadLocalData.InFlightData: Pointer to in-flight TLS data for fields being initialized
Thread.ThreadLocalData.NonCollectibleTlsArrayDa: Pointer to non-collectible TLS array data
Thread.ThreadLocalData.NonCollectibleTlsDataCou: Count of non-collectible TLS data entries
Thread.ThreadStore.FirstThreadLink: Pointer to first thread in the linked list
Thread.TLSIndex.TLSIndexRawIndex: Raw index value containing type and offset
